conclusion: the cross-validated ceiling for this bank and target is about 0.597

feature_engineering.note: 15 almanac tables, each collapsed from ~144 sparse binary cells to one continuous statement whose cells borrow strength from their row and column marginals. Selected only at weak shrinkage, where they overfit; at the CV-winning shrinkage none survives.

selection_rules_note: adaptive Lasso first returned zero rules at every alpha: scaling the design by the first-pass coefficients shrinks it by their mean, so an unscaled alpha annihilates it. Rescaled, it measures 0.5951 — a harness bug, not a verdict on the method.
